flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/{jobs/ToppanLettersGeneratorJob, jobs/ToppanUploadJob, helpers/ToppanUploadHelper (getValidOffenceNoticesOptimized, enrichNoticesWithAddressesOptimized, filterByLetterAddress, updateProcessingStage, resetLetterAddressAfterToppan, bulkRecordDriverNotices), models/ToppanStage}, framework/services/agencyFileExchange/AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl (createToppanRequestFileContent), framework/services/comcryptSftpBlob/helper/ComcryptUploadProcessor, framework/schedulers/ToppanUploadJobsScheduler, framework/controllers/ToppanUnifiedController, workflows/furnish_processing/helpers/FurnishApprovalHelper (furnished_mail letter_address), crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.findToppanNoticesForStage, resources application-prod.properties and cron-schedules-prod.properties. Other repos: no Toppan letter code
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo_remark: SFTP Code Split, SFTP connection permission is granted to the App Service (cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck, so Sesuai means the code follows the story text. The 'first reminder letter to the driver' in the code is stage DN1 (ToppanStage 'Demand Notice 1') through the same Toppan path as RD1/RR3 (see OCMS12.2 and OCMS12.17). The story precondition 'OCMS decides to offer composition' is not automatic (OCMS12.36). Gaps: (1) letter generation only runs through the manual trigger because executeJob() in the day-end scheduler is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118); (2) sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in application-prod.properties:86 (same in dev and uat) blocks upload to the Toppan SFTP; (3) the delivery gate is bypassed so the stage still advances without the file being delivered (OCMS-DF-2026-192, Ready to UAT; the block was installed through OCMS-DF-2026-170, Closed); (4) the letter_address reset after Toppan does not include furnished_mail. It is a data file, not a PDF; the vendor makes the PDF. The letter content and Toppan's receipt of the file cannot be verified from the repo.
recommendation: Claim partially. DN1 notice selection, use of the furnished address and data file creation exist; delivery to the vendor does not run according to the repo configuration and the daily trigger is not active. Confirm with URA once the Toppan SFTP block is lifted and the day-end schedule calls letter generation; test the case of a driver who only has a furnished_mail address.

steps.step: Driver notices due at stage DN1 are selected for the 1st letter reminder
steps.detail: findToppanNoticesForStage selects notices with next_processing_stage = DN1, next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type NULL, an_flag not Y, and only the owner_driver row with offender_indicator Y (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:583-614), called from getValidOffenceNoticesOptimized (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1887). Unpaid Foreign vehicles are filtered out and set to PS-FOR (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1950). The query does not distinguish owner/hirer/driver; the driver is included because furnish puts them as offender Y at DN1 (OCMS12.36). Stage DN1 is processed by ToppanLettersGeneratorJob together with RD1 through ANL (ToppanLettersGeneratorJob.java:151-176). The 00:15 schedule exists and is enabled=true (cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62), but the executeJob() call in the scheduler is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118); letters are only produced through the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters (ToppanUnifiedController.java:34-40). So 'sent automatically' is not proven. Sebagian.

steps.step: The letter is addressed to the driver address provided by the vehicle owner or hirer
steps.detail: When the furnish is approved, the form address is saved as furnished_mail with letter_address Y (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:627-634) and the old offender's letter_address Y is nulled (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:607-620). When the file is built, enrichment takes the address row with letter_address Y (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2196-2200), sets the hasLetterAddressY flag (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2236), and a notice without that address is dropped (ToppanUploadJob.java:266). So the DN1 letter uses the address given by the furnisher. Other jobs that write letter_address before DN1 is processed are not re-traced here.

steps.step: OCMS creates the data file of the 1st letter reminder for the vendor (Toppan)
steps.detail: The file is named URA-DPT-DN1-D1-yyyyMMddHHmmss (ToppanUploadJob.java:279-281) and its content is built by createToppanRequestFileContent: one 719-character header, then one 719-character detail line per notice (letter date, notice no, name, address, vehicle no, place, rule), sorted by postal code, with the NRIC column deliberately left blank (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:564-600, 645-700). The story says 'PDF/data files'; what is produced is a data file, the vendor makes the PDF (cannot verify from repo). OCMS only makes a PDF for stage ANL. The driver letter text on Toppan's side cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: The file is sent to the vendor through SFTP (via blob and COMCRYPT encryption)
steps.detail: The file is uploaded to blob (ToppanUploadJob.java:314) and then OCMS requests a COMCRYPT token (ToppanUploadJob.java:349-356); the callback encrypts and uploads to the Toppan SFTP. But application-prod.properties:86 sets sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (same in dev and uat), and ComcryptUploadProcessor throws SftpDisabledException for that server (ComcryptUploadProcessor.java:203-208). From the repo configuration, the DN1 file does not reach the Toppan SFTP. OCMS-DF-2026-170 (Closed) installed this block; OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT) discusses its impact. The real value on the PROD server and Toppan's receipt of the file cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: The notice is marked as sent: stage advances from DN1 to DN2 and is recorded as a driver notice
steps.detail: The stage advances through updateProcessingStage after delivery is confirmed (ToppanUploadJob.java:405-444, OCMS-DEV-2026-199): the VON gets last_processing_stage = DN1 (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1514) and next from ocms_stage_map with the enum fallback DN2 (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1813-1821), the row is recorded in ocms_driver_notice (ToppanUploadHelper.java:892-897), then letter_address is reset (ToppanUploadHelper.java:327-330). But while sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan, the delivery gate is bypassed and the stage still advances even though the file is not delivered (ToppanUploadJob.java:424-444; OCMS-DF-2026-192, Ready to UAT). In addition, the letter_address reset uses the order mha_reg -> lta_reg -> lta_mail without furnished_mail (ToppanUploadHelper.java:498-517) while the old rows are cleared (ToppanUploadHelper.java:494), so a driver who only has a furnished_mail address loses letter_address Y after DN1 and will be filtered out at DN2 (ToppanUploadJob.java:266). The last point comes from reading the code and is not tested.
